Jordan

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — compliance wording + demo plan

Thanks — reviewed the draft matrix and made edits. High-level notes:

- Avoid unqualified claims like "HIPAA compliant" or "PII-safe." Instead use phrasing such as: "Can be configured to run in HIPAA-aligned environments when deployed in customer-managed VPCs" or "Supports PHI handling with customer-managed keys and appropriate BAA in place."
- For data residency: on the product page say "Regional deployment options available (US, EU)" and reference the Private deployment product page for specifics.
- For evidence: procurement will accept SOC 2 Type II report (summary), DPA excerpt, and architecture diagram showing KMS/HSM flow. I added these to the spreadsheet under Evidence Type.

Suggested product-page copy (short blurb + bullets) — feel free to share to Acme directly:

Product blurb (one paragraph):
Redwood Inference is a high-throughput inference platform that lets teams run open and fine-tuned models with predictable latency and cost. Deployments can be hosted, dedicated, or private to meet data residency and security requirements.

Claim bullets (concise):
• Flexible deployment modes: hosted API, dedicated GPU pools, and private VPC/on-prem options.
• Security controls: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logs, and VPC isolation.
• Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II coverage, contractual DPA, and optional on-prem package for regulated workloads.
• Production-grade guarantees: configurable autoscaling, SLA-backed latency targets for Dedicated customers.

I attached a plain-text draft (aws_listing_copy_draft.md) that fits the Marketplace length constraints. Also added a Drive folder with the evidence binder (link in related_links).

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Enablement, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Final: AWS Marketplace copy + demo slate (slots + access)

Jordan / Procurement team — thanks for the patience. Per our workstream: attached is the final product page blurb and claim bullets we recommend for the AWS listing (language chosen to be audit-friendly), plus the demo slate below. If procurement needs any additional artifacts (SOC 2 summary PDF or DPA excerpt), we can provide those via the Drive link.

Final product blurb:
Redwood Inference delivers a production-grade inference platform for running and optimizing large language models across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. The platform prioritizes predictable latency, cost controls, and enterprise-grade security so teams can scale LLM features reliably.

Final claim bullets (for listing):
• Deployment flexibility: hosted API, reserved GPU capacity, and private (VPC/on-prem) deployments.
• Security primitives: customer-managed KMS/HSM support, audit logs, and network isolation.
• Compliance options: SOC 2 Type II attestation available; contractual DPA and on-prem options for regulated data.
• Operational guarantees: configurable autoscaling and SLA-backed Dedicated tiers for predictable throughput.

Demo slate (60–75 minutes):
1) 10m intro + success criteria (Jordan, field lead)
2) 20m live inference demo (sample prompts, latency and throughput monitoring)
3) 15m security walkthrough (VPC, KMS flow, audit logs)
4) 15m test run with Acme sample dataset in a private sandbox (if Acme prefers)
5) 5m next steps and action items

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-02 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2026-06-03 14:00–15:15
- Fri 2026-06-05 09:00–10:15

Access notes: we will provide a time-limited sandbox key and a short runbook for the private sandbox. Sean will coordinate infra access and send calendar invites once you confirm a slot.

Links & attachments: evidence binder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-evidence; final demo slate attached (demo_slate_final.pdf).

If this looks good, Jordan — please confirm preferred slot and we'll lock it in.
